prioritize_descent_over_exploration.title: Prioritize descent over exploration
prioritize_descent_over_exploration.content: Find stairs FAST: request_map → np_move_to('>') → np_press_key('>'). Don't explore every room or grab every item. Budget is limited — spend on descent, not looting.

vault_guard_mechanic.title: Vault guard mechanic
vault_guard_mechanic.content: Vault guard asks name: type 1-2 letters + ENTER. Then d + $ to drop gold, follow guard out. NEVER re-pick gold — guard turns hostile and kills you.

explore_level_near_peaceful_npcs.title: explore_level near peaceful NPCs
explore_level_near_peaceful_npcs.content: np_explore_level paths through guards/peaceful NPCs, triggering 'Really attack?' prompt loops. Use np_move_to to walk away from them FIRST, then explore.

answer_prompts_don_t_repeat_skills.title: Answer prompts, don't repeat skills
answer_prompts_don_t_repeat_skills.content: When a prompt/menu is open the game is FROZEN. Answer ONLY with np_press_key. Re-calling explore or move re-triggers the same prompt — pure waste.

descend_one_level.title: Descend one level
descend_one_level.content: Standard descent: request_map to find '>', np_move_to to stairs tile, np_press_key('>'). If move_to fails on closed door, np_kick it first.
